analyst_view.overall: Early view: a top-four meeting, with Eibar fourth on 23 points from 12 games and Burgos third on 24 after a late 2-1 win over Celta Fortuna. One report (4 November) says Eibar lost both left-backs, Juan Bernat (torn hamstring) and Imanol García de Albéniz (torn calf), and have Unai Elgezabal out with an ankle sprain. Eibar also have a postponed league game at Castellón and a Copa tie to fit in, so the schedule could be tight by late November.

goals.text: The numbers say 1.9 goals. I lean higher: Eibar's home games have averaged nearly three goals, Burgos keep scoring late (Álex Forés in the 86th minute last time), and Eibar's patched-up back line without Bernat and García de Albéniz is a weakness.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.1 corners. I lean higher: Burgos won 10 corners against Celta Fortuna under Sergio Francisco, and Eibar's makeshift full-backs could invite pressure down the flanks, while Eibar themselves had 20 shots and five corners against Almería.

cards.text: The numbers say 5.2 cards. Eibar had three yellows against Almería and Burgos only one against Celta Fortuna; it is a big game at a tight ground, but neither side has been especially card-prone lately, so I stay with the number.

shots.text: The numbers say 26.1 shots. I lean higher: Eibar had 20 shots against Almería and Burgos 19 against Celta Fortuna, and both like to shoot from volume.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 8.4 shots on target. Eibar's volume has not turned into accuracy (four on target from 20, eight blocked, against Almería), while Burgos had six on target last time, so I stay close to the site's number.
